findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] No user-controlled key reaches a file reference in app/apis/menu/utils.py. The only externally supplied locator is image_url, which is not a filesystem path: it must be https, its hostname must appear in settings.ALLOWED_IMAGE_HOSTS (an empty list fails closed), every resolved address is rejected if private/loopback/link-local/reserved/multicast, redirects are refused, and the retrieved bytes are digest- and signature-checked then parsed as an allow-listed image format before being stored as base64 in the database. No path is derived from input, so no traversal such as '../config.xml' is expressible. Menu item_id is a direct integer reference, but it addresses publicly readable content whose every mutation re-checks authz.require(Permission.MANAGE_MENU) at the point the data changes. Alternative mitigation accepted: host allow-listing plus permission enforcement supplies the access-control property the indirect-reference map exists to provide | verdict=pass confidence=high
